prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D side-scrolling game sprite sheet, original fan-made adaptation of adult D-Dog from Metal Gear Solid V The Phantom Pain, faithful to official Konami Play Arts Kai D-Dog photographs. Gray-and-cream wolf-dog, tall upright pointed ears, cream muzzle and throat ruff, gray back, bushy dark-tipped tail. Black eyepatch over HIS RIGHT eye, matte black fitted Diamond Dogs tactical harness / dark segmented sneaking suit covering torso, forelegs and hindlegs while furry head and tail remain uncovered. Not a puppy, not generic brown German shepherd, not robotic, not chibi. Crisp detailed pixel-art, realistic canine anatomy. EXACT four columns and four rows, 16 separately authored poses on flat saturated #FF00FF background. Thin cyan grid lines, equal square cells. Side orthographic view, all face RIGHT; same scale, common paw baseline with generous empty margins around entire dog and tail in every cell. Row1 four distinct idle sniffing / alert ear phases. Row2 four genuinely distinct walking gait phases, alternating paws. Row3 four interaction phases: sit, attentive head turn, short bark, returning standing. Row4 four alert reaction phases: crouch tense, one forepaw lifted, step back, recover. No violence or injury. No floor shadow, no scenery, no text or logos or UI. No clipping of ears, paws or tail; each pose fits entirely in its own cell. REGENERATION REQUIRED for clean extractable geometry: Each dog must occupy at most SIXTY PERCENT of its square cell width and at most sixty percent cell height. Put all figures in the center of cells with a continuous magenta moat at least 20 percent of cell width from nose/tail to both cyan vertical lines. The extended tail and muzzle must NEVER touch any boundary. Common baseline 78 percent cell height. Reduce the entire dog, do not shorten tail or muzzle. No floating speech lines. Keep exactly16 poses and canonical black suit gray-cream adult DDog identity.

rejected.reason: Tail/nose too close to or touching cyan cell border.

review: Second source: all 16 poses have clear boundary margins. Adult gray cream canine, black tactical suit and eyepatch. Head-turn pose intentional. Original fan-made pixel adaptation; not 1:1 guaranteed.
